name: (01) Protean — 2 Intermediate — Shape of the Beast Revisited

system.description: Gangrel-only variant of Shape of the Beast. The Gangrel defines a "fight" form and a "flight" form when learning this power (fixed thereafter, unlike the standard wolf/bat-only version other clans use). Spend a Blood Trait to transform (three turns, reducible to one by spending up to three additional Blood Traits); lasts until dawn or until voluntarily ended. Each form adds five bonus Traits split across at least two of Strength/Dexterity/Stamina/Perception/Wits-related categories (fixed once chosen). Bite inflicts two levels and claws one level of aggravated damage by default (Storyteller may reweight for the animal in question). Movement doubles in animal form. The flight form is capped at three Physical Traits (from the character's normal list), flies at running speed, and permits declaring Fair Escape once five paces from the nearest non-superior-speed pursuer; attacks against it take a two-Trait penalty unless the character opts to keep full Strength-related Traits instead.
